channel.title: NGB Ventures: Insights from India
channel.description: Stories from India's craft and food regions, and practical guides for international buyers.

item.title: Millets: India's ancient grains, ready for global shelves
item.description: Ragi, jowar, bajra and the small millets: what they are, where India grows them, which products buyers can source, and what to check for export.

item.title: From spice garden to spice rack: sourcing spices from India
item.description: Where India's major spices come from, how export-grade processing works, the tests that protect you at the border, and how to brief a private-label spice range.

item.title: Planning a corporate gift programme with Indian makers
item.description: How to plan memorable corporate gifts from India: budgets, curation, branding, timelines, customs pitfalls and multi-address delivery, step by step.

item.title: Moradabad: the brass city that sets tables around the world
item.description: How a city in Uttar Pradesh became India's best-known metalware cluster, the techniques its artisans use, and what buyers should know before ordering brass and metal products.

item.title: Kannauj: inside India's perfume city
item.description: The copper stills, the rose and vetiver harvests, and the slow distillation that make Kannauj attar unique, plus how buyers can source natural fragrance responsibly.

item.title: Indian tea and coffee for private label: estates, grades and what to ask
item.description: Assam, Darjeeling and Nilgiri teas, orthodox versus CTC, Indian arabica and robusta, Monsooned Malabar, and how to brief an estate-sourced private-label range.

item.title: Makhana, moringa, turmeric and ashwagandha: a buyer's guide to Indian superfoods
item.description: Where India's best-known superfoods and botanicals are grown, the product formats available, the quality tests that matter and the claim rules that trip up new brands.

item.title: Hand block print or screen print? How to source authentic Indian textiles
item.description: How to tell hand block printing, handloom and ikat from machine imitations, where each craft comes from, and how to brief artisans so your range is authentic and consistent.

item.title: Private label from India: from first sample to shelf
item.description: A practical path for brands launching private-label products made in India: choosing the product, finding the maker, developing samples, packaging, compliance and the first order.

item.title: Plastic-free from India: jute, coir, bamboo and paper for sustainable brands
item.description: How India's natural-fibre industries supply plastic-free packaging and products, which material suits which use, and how to verify sustainability claims.

item.title: Incoterms for India imports: EXW, FOB, CIF, DAP and DDP explained
item.description: Which Incoterms 2020 rules buyers commonly use when importing from India, who pays what, where risk transfers, and practical pitfalls.

item.title: How to source from India: a practical guide for international buyers
item.description: A step-by-step framework for sourcing products from Indian manufacturers: briefs, clusters, supplier verification, sampling, quality control, Incoterms and documentation.
